question: Do institution-specific bibliographic records agree on metal type used in the 1458 交食推步法 / 交食推步法假令, and does their comparison bind a specific original 盈縮加分 formula page or G893 source-original numeric unit?

evidence.provider: Seoul National University Kyujanggak first-party public catalog
evidence.catalog_literal: 古活字本(大字는 丙辰字, 中字는 甲寅字)

evidence.provider: Academy of Korean Studies 한국민족문화대백과사전 (scholarly encyclopedia)
evidence.entry_note: 1995 authorship; last revision shown 2026-04-14; encyclopedia warns scholarly opinion may differ from institutional position
evidence.recorded_claim: 戊寅字 cast in 1458 for main large characters of 交食推步法假令; 甲寅字 used for smaller annotation text

discrepancy.surface: 大字 丙辰字 in SNU catalog versus large main-print 戊寅字 in AKS type-history description
possible_scope_explanations: Cataloged 交食推步法 versus historical account naming 交食推步法假令 may distinguish extent or edition
Different extant impressions or type-classification levels may explain apparent variance; neither is demonstrated here
Original-page visual typeform comparison is required before assigning an error to either description
discrepancy.positive: Two distinct, individually specified publication/type attribution claims can be replayed at their own bibliographic scopes; they must not be silently merged into a single 1458 source-impression identity.
discrepancy.next_check: Use a provider-emitted or authorized source-native 奎貴67 formula leaf (native image URL, page, pixel digest) together with item-specific colophon/typeform evidence; separately recheck G893 original 少 field/radix and limit boundaries. Avoid inferred URL enumeration.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Same or similar 1458 title/type descriptions cannot establish same printing type of SNU 奎貴67 without its physical page and imprint collated.
Work-level scholar account cannot override item-level catalog or vice versa without original-copy evidence.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Does SNU 奎貴67 use 丙辰字 and/or 戊寅字 on the formula target leaf? Are the catalog and type-history statements about different printing extents/physical impressions?
What is the source-original G893 少/微 and edition-scoped arithmetic?
